title: 雙人車 一個人騎
subject: a woman at a riverside bike-rental shop counter ending the annual tandem-bicycle rental her ex signed them both up for, while the owner keeps asking where the other rider is; she takes the tandem out alone for one last lap along the river before handing it back
caption: Mandarin indie-sleaze dance-rock, 2000s loft-party dance-rock as revived in 2025. A choppy, dry-toned electric guitar riff in sixteenths, a disco hi-hat drum kit with cowbell on the off-beats, a driving octave-jumping bass line, a cheap analog synth arpeggio, handclaps. Loose, bright, slightly overdriven mix with short room reverb. Female lead, half-sung half-spoken and deadpan, belting the hook with small group shouts. 128 BPM, A minor. Furious, funny and cathartic. No punk shouting, no blast-beat drums, no trap beat, no autotune, no ballad breakdown, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - choppy guitar riff and cowbell, bass joins]

[Verse 1]
河濱租車店 老闆在打瞌睡
我把租約拍在櫃台上
那台雙人車 綠色的 前面那個座位
是他簽的 一年一約

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆抬頭問 另一個人呢
我說 你別問了

[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的踏板 自己在轉
你問他呢 他早就下車
我今天 來退這台

[Verse 2]
老闆又問 要不要換單人的
他說雙人的 一個人很難騎
我說去年也是我在踩
他坐後面 只負責拍照

[Pre-Chorus]
老闆又問 那他還來嗎
我說 你再問一次試試

[Chorus - full band, group shouts]
雙人車 一個人騎
後面的座位 載著風
你問他呢 他在別人後座
我最後 再騎一圈

[Bridge - guitar drops out, bass and cowbell]
沿著河 騎過那座橋
龍頭有點歪 我也不管
押金退給我 本人在這
一千二 一毛都別少

[Outro - riff returns, then cuts dead]
停好車 鑰匙還你
我走路回家 快多了
